name: Track Analysis
author: pedro
summary: Generate missing track phrases on the deck and save them to USB.
description: Runs the DJTrackAnalysis beat and phrase algorithm in a background process for USB OneLibrary tracks without saved phrases. Preserves populated grids, phrases, cues and waveform data. Requires the core analysis publication service. This development version supports MP3, FLAC and WAV files, including library tracks with no previous ANLZ location. Streaming, folder-only tracks and native phrase-display refresh are not yet supported.
